about_heading: Why is this tour to Egypt special?
about_lead: There are places that remain beyond the usual tourist routes — and the Siwa Oasis is one of them.
about_p1: Most tourists travelling through Egypt will never see Siwa. The oasis lies nearly 800 km across the Sahara — there is no mass tourism, large resort hotels, or noisy tour groups.
about_p2: There is only the silence of the desert, ancient temples, salt lakes of an extraordinary color, and the feeling that time itself is slowing down.
about_p3: The Siwa Oasis is one of the last places in Egypt where Berber traditions, a unique way of life, and the atmosphere of a true lost paradise are preserved.
about_quote: Alexander the Great once came here to receive a prophecy at the Temple of Amun-Ra. Today it is one of Egypt's most mysterious and least-visited places. We will travel there together.
about_accent: This author's tour is for those who want to see a different Egypt — not touristy, not postcard-perfect. Alive and deep.

prog_d1_text: Arrival in Cairo. Group meeting. Hotel check-in. Introductions and rest after the journey.
prog_d2_title: One of the Seven Wonders of the World
prog_d2_text: The Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx. Visit to the new Grand Egyptian Museum — the world's largest archaeological museum with the treasures of Tutankhamun.
prog_d3_text: Saqqara — the Step Pyramid of Djoser. Serapeum — underground galleries with mysterious 70-ton granite sarcophagi whose secret remains unsolved.
prog_d4_text: The road through the Sahara is a journey in itself. First views of the oasis. Evening swim in natural desert hot springs.
prog_d5_text: Salt lakes with turquoise water. Cleopatra's Bath — a natural spring thousands of years old. Introduction to oasis life and Berber traditions.
prog_d6_label: Day 6 | Temple of Amun-Ra and safari
prog_d6_title: Mysticism and the Great Sand Sea
prog_d6_text: The Oracle Temple of Amun-Ra — one of Egypt's most mystical sites. Practice in the space of the ancient sanctuary. Jeep safari across the Great Sand Sea. Sunset among the Sahara dunes. Dinner under the desert starry sky.
prog_d7_text: Rest. Shopping — Berber jewelry, olive oil, Siwa dates. Walks through the oasis. Evening gathering by the campfire.
prog_d8_text: Early departure across the desert. Return to Cairo. End of the tour.

flower_about_h2: Ancient Wisdom That Was Waiting for You
flower_about_lead: The Flower of Life is not just an excursion tour. It is a deep transformation through resonance with the most ancient places of power on Earth.
flower_about_p1: On the walls of the underground Osireion temple in Abydos, one of humanity's oldest and most mysterious symbols is carved — the Flower of Life. It is etched into granite by an unknown method at the molecular level.
flower_about_p2: We journey to Egypt to walk the path of ancient initiations: from unconditional love in the Temple of Hathor to deep rebirth in mystical Abydos.
flower_about_p3: This is a journey of inner transformation — where ancient stones become a mirror, and sacred geometry becomes the language of the soul.
flower_about_quote: When your body and mind enter the harmonic frequency of Egypt's temples, a natural process of self-restoration and activation of your spiritual potential begins.
flower_about_accent: This retreat is for those who are ready for deep inner work and seek not tourism, but initiation.
flower_gift1_text: Ancient temples and pyramids as points of awakening.
flower_gift2_text: Asanas and pranayamas under the Egyptian dawn.
flower_gift3_text: Voice, mantras, vibrations — tuning the vessel.
flower_gift4_text: Free movement as the body's prayer.
flower_gift5_text: Creating your own Flower of Life painting.
flower_gift6_text: A warm circle of women and a guide by your side.
flower_day1_text: Welcoming participants in Luxor. Check-in at a comfortable hotel on the banks of the Nile. Evening opening circle, introduction to the retreat space, and formation of personal intention for the journey.
flower_day2_text: Early departure to Dendera. Exploring the breathtaking temple complex of Hathor, goddess of love, music, and motherhood. Visiting the underground crypts and practicing heart-center activation beneath the ancient zodiac ceilings.
flower_day3_title: Temple of Isis on Philae Island
flower_day3_text: Transfer to Abydos — Egypt's most ancient spiritual center. Immersion in the atmosphere of the Temple of Seti I with its unique bas-reliefs. Visiting the underground Osireion, where the Flower of Life is carved. Practice of attuning to the matrix of creation.
flower_day4_text: Exploring the Luxor Temple, built according to the laws of sacred proportion of the human body. Evening meditation in the glow of the colonnades' nighttime illumination.
flower_day5_title: Temples of Medinet Habu and Hatshepsut
flower_day5_text: Visiting the majestic Karnak complex. Meditative practice in the closed sanctuary of the lion-headed goddess Sekhmet — transforming inner blocks into power.
flower_day6_text: Exploring the west bank of the Nile, the tombs of the Valley of the Kings, and the Temple of Hatshepsut. Practice of grounding, integrating received knowledge, and deep relaxation.
flower_day7_text: Morning integration practice, recording retreat results. Closing circle of gratitude. Transfer to the airport.
flower_day8_text: Returning home with a new inner resource and a deep understanding of your sacred nature.
